line: Sunny Sunday energy. Go out, eat well and leave the laptop shut.
You've got something to say today. Say it over lunch, not over text.
Your crowd is bright today. Gather people; you'll be the warmest one there.
Someone takes the spotlight today. Clap for them; your turn is coming.
A slow morning brings a clear answer. Don't rush the coffee.
Family has your back today. Let them help with the chores for once.
Sunday pressure creeps in. Prep Monday for 20 minutes, then stop.
Someone praises your taste today. Take the compliment; don't explain it.
A fun chance pops up today. Say yes if it fits your wallet.
Plan the week's spending today. Ten minutes now saves stress later.
